test_title: PYST 67: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

TUG : QYD

NCA : KGX
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2898f16e0fb74b7aba024f5ed65e35b3eb943b2709a94fc45401ed1c7a6fb8c0.png] 

Logic followed here is: The letters in the first word of the pair are shifted by specific positional values (-3, +4, -3) to obtain the letters in the second word of the pair.

**For TUG : QYD →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa298a9a9c1be7b2262270c1838d70fdc1f4781202d43f12ca0720dec846588b.png] 

**For NCA : KGX →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d05d6114cac162d2e992f02dcaa6e36b766c2fdbad67e3c7cba4905821d366c.png] 

**Similarly,Option 4) HKU : EOR:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2396251bd57fa10f93b76bdc6786b7f92867edeaa46b5888e0c454c4c5db9819.png] 

Therefore, the pair 'HKU : EOR' follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
